chunks.front: Stand in the plague of custom,
Who, in the lusty stealth of nature,

beats.label: Invoke Nature
beats.intention: To pledge allegiance to Nature above the customs of society

beats.label: Challenge The Custom
beats.intention: To reject the label of bastard as an accident of birth timing

beats.label: Assert Equality
beats.intention: To argue his body and mind are as fit as any legitimate son's

beats.label: Boast Superior Origin
beats.intention: To claim that bastards, conceived in lusty stealth, carry more vigor than the legitimate

beats.label: Plot Against Edgar
beats.intention: To set the letter scheme in motion and take Edgar's inheritance

beats.label: Claim Triumph
beats.intention: To declare his coming victory and rally the gods to his cause

soliloquies.title: These late eclipses in the sun and moon

chunks.front: These late eclipses in the sun and moon
Though the wisdom of nature can reason it thus and thus,
chunks.back: yet nature finds itself scourged by the sequent effects.
The king falls from bias of nature—
We have seen the best of our time.
And the noble and true-hearted Kent banished!

beats.label: Read The Omens
beats.intention: To interpret the eclipses as portents of cosmic disorder

beats.label: Catalog The Corruption
beats.intention: To enumerate how the disorder infects every human bond, from love to state

beats.label: Apply It To My House
beats.intention: To fit the pattern to Edgar's supposed treachery and Lear's fall

beats.label: Lament The Age
beats.intention: To mourn that the best days are behind and disorder will trail us to the grave

beats.label: Command And Marvel
beats.intention: To task Edmund with rooting out the villain, then marvel at Kent's honest banishment

soliloquies.title: This is the excellent foppery of the world

chunks.front: This is the excellent foppery of the world,
chunks.back: that when we are sick in fortune—

chunks.front: we make guilty of our disasters
chunks.back: the sun, the moon, and the stars;

chunks.front: as if we were villains by necessity,

chunks.back: by an enforced obedience of planetary influence;

chunks.front: and all that we are evil in,
An admirable evasion of whoremaster man,
to the charge of a star!
chunks.back: My father compounded with my mother
and my nativity was under Ursa Major,

chunks.front: Fut, I should have been that I am

beats.label: Expose The Foppery
beats.intention: To name humanity's astrological self-deception as absurd

beats.label: List The False Excuses
beats.intention: To itemize the vices men blame on the stars — villainy, folly, thievery, drunkenness

beats.label: Name The Evasion
beats.intention: To label the whole enterprise as men fobbing their appetites off onto the heavens

beats.label: Ironize Himself
beats.intention: To mock the logic by ostentatiously applying it to his own conception

beats.label: Reject The Whole Argument
beats.intention: To declare he'd be exactly who he is regardless of any star's twinkle
